- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover

- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Interaction Simulator Sub-Flow: Adds an interactive practice sub-flow to the finish screen where users can test dragging, hiding, and talking to their pet before completing setup. (why: 3 support tickets cited confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to pets after onboarding, and past finish new_flow changes won 2 out of 5 tests.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Hatching Companion Activity Feed Screen: Inserts a dedicated activity feed screen during pet rendering that shows real-time companion asset creation status updates. (why: The waiting step has a high median wait time of 201s (mean 2336s), and home wait_info changes have succeeded in 4 out of 7 tests.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Multi-Device Pet Restoration Hint: Displays explicit reassurance text under sign-in choices explaining that logging in restores any existing pet progress across devices. (why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign-in hints have won 5 out of 11 tests previously.)
3: [finish, redesign] Finish Companion Interaction Shortcut Layout Redesign: Redesigns the finish screen into a full-bleed visual layout displaying key mouse gestures and desktop pet shortcuts. (why: Multiple users were confused about how to hide or interact with pets after onboarding, and finish step improvements help drive final onboarding completion.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Rendering Completion Sound & Alert Switch: Adds a sound notification switch and system alert checkbox on the waiting screen so users know when rendering finishes. (why: The home wait step takes median 201s (mean 2336s); notifying users when ready prevents them from abandoning the app while waiting.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Asset Recovery Guarantee Hint: Adds reassuring hint text below authentication buttons confirming that account login safeguards custom pets from being reset. (why: 8 users emailed support about missing or reset pets post-login, making sign-in security reassurance a high-leverage opportunity.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Account Data Transfer Hint: Adds a clear hint on the path selection screen confirming that choosing a path preserves all desktop settings and saved data. (why: Addresses recurring user anxiety regarding data loss or pet resets when choosing onboarding options.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Companion Asset Construction Live Timer Display: Displays an active countdown timer alongside time estimates on the waiting screen while pet assets are being built. (why: High mean wait time (2336s) during home step leads to drop-offs; live wait info has proven effective in improving home retention.)
